study.question: Does auxiliary supervision help click AUC at the imported strongest joint model, and is any effect transmitted through the remaining context adapter gradient paths?
study.hypothesis: Useful or harmful auxiliary information reaches shared context embeddings through the task-specific residual and multiplicative context/history adapter inputs. The incumbent already detaches auxiliary item/action inputs, the shared scorer parameters, primary pooled strata, and direct tower context inputs. Removing all auxiliary losses tests net utility; detaching the two remaining context edges tests direct representation transfer; replacing only the auxiliary training targets tests whether aligned auxiliary information matters beyond generic task optimization. These are prospective alternatives, not established benefits or a novel architecture claim.

nearest_work.difference: Exact imported model/config is the nearest local architectural reference. Preserve all its representations and forward operators. Change training-only loss participation or its existing auxiliary adapter-context detach gate. This is a controlled supervision study, with no claim to a new architecture.

Archived primary text lines75-93 and the version4 abstract support target-conditioned local activation and adaptive activation. Those operators are inherited through the local field/four-task adaptation; the proposed contrast concerns auxiliary supervision in a substantially extended joint model, not an exact DIN reproduction or priority claim.

Pinned upstream add_loss lines85-92 sums mean per-task losses under EQ. The proposed registered training_loss hook makes selected auxiliary participation explicit while preserving click weight1; host must verify the frozen harness default rather than assume upstream code is the whole host recipe.

Pinned benchmark forward lines119-155 shares a unified token representation across task towers. The current model instead has compressed-history summaries and task-specific adapters with restricted source gradients. No EST architecture is added; its unified/shared design does not establish local auxiliary-supervision utility.

Pinned benchmark forward lines135-142 reads a common unified token mean through task heads. This study preserves the imported context/history product model and tests selective auxiliary transfer. Original MixFormer paper details remain unaudited; no reproduction or originality claim.

Action-aware unnormalized local activation, native Dice and folded support populations

study.proposed_difference: Four standalone modules share the identical inherited model plus one training-only hook. joint_replay sums four true-label mean BCEs; click_only sets the three auxiliary BCE coefficients to zero but retains their graph and forward state; aux_context_blocked uses four true-label BCEs and detaches the existing auxiliary adapter context edge (both residual and product adapter uses); aux_batch_roll uses click truth unchanged and a deterministic half-batch cyclic reassignment of the three auxiliary label columns as a joint triple only inside the training-loss hook. Labels in host data/scoring and all historical input masks are unchanged. The loss-control objective is a module-local literal; CONFIG contains model options only. All arms compute four BCEs and the same label-roll temporary; no new modules, learnable state or RNG.
predictions: If aligned auxiliary supervision is useful, joint_replay click AUC exceeds click_only and the batch-roll control under matched exposure; the relevant differences should recur in subsequent paired seeds.

If the remaining shared-context path carries that utility, aux_context_blocked loses some joint_replay benefit while retaining true auxiliary supervision and task-private learning. If harmful, blocking or removing auxiliary supervision can improve click AUC instead.

Before any parameter update, all four arms have identical probabilities and running-buffer trajectories for identical state and batches. joint_replay must match imported-parent loss and gradients within a predeclared numeric tolerance under the frozen loss preprocessing.

With auxiliary-only true loss and nonzero adapter output matrices on a diagnostic clone, the open arm can update context embeddings through both adapters; the blocked arm has zero auxiliary gradients to all shared representation parameters. Item/action/scorer paths stay blocked in both.

Learned parameter count remains32192421 total,31793216 embedding and399205 dense as imported. Inference predictions at equal state and inference cost should match; realized train cost and gradient clipping behavior must be measured, not inferred.
falsifiers: No reproducible click AUC advantage for joint_replay over click_only falsifies useful auxiliary supervision for this architecture under this recipe, not all auxiliary learning methods.
Joint-replay advantage equally reproduced by batch-roll targets fails to support task-aligned supervision as its cause.

An effect persisting with verified blocked shared-context gradients cannot be attributed wholly to direct auxiliary context transfer; clipping/optimizer coupling, aliases, failed parity or hidden paths must be investigated.
Nonzero blocked auxiliary gradients into shared representation parameters after opening adapter outputs invalidates this implementation as a clean source-path control.

Forward, initialization, buffer, label/mask or primary-loss parity failure invalidates the corresponding contrast. Missing host diagnostics leave mechanism attribution unresolved rather than supporting it.
alternative_explanations: One fixed training seed does not establish repeatability or significance.

Global dense clipping uses all dense task parameters: blocking shared context gradients does not remove task-private norm contributions. Compare clipping rates/scales and primary updates before attributing any residual blocked-versus-click-only difference.
Batch-roll replacement preserves labels and correlations but can retain user/batch/time structure, and its gradient norms can differ; it is not a proof of independent null supervision.
Prediction differences alone do not identify gradient conflict; inspect authorized training-only gradients and retain uncertainty if unavailable.
The incumbent-versus-DIN click gain and auxiliary decline are bundled architecture comparisons; neither establishes auxiliary benefit, harm or a tradeoff mechanism.
Auxiliary labels are24h user/category/brand matches rather than advertisement-specific conversions; historical actions remain informative in click-only training.

Changing auxiliary gradients changes sparse Adagrad accumulated squares and shared context trajectories. A favorable gradient cosine in one diagnostic batch is insufficient for a trajectory explanation.

click_only retains zero-weight graph terms so auxiliary-private gradients are zeros rather than necessarily absent; AdamW weight decay/state handling must be checked. Auxiliary evaluation in that arm is not a trained-auxiliary quality claim.

At zero adapter output initialization, auxiliary context gradients may be zero even in open arms. Gradient checks must also open both output paths on cloned state and later inspect natural training checkpoints.

Only baseline-din and g0-r0039-context_product are authorized local trajectories. Their successful receipts and source lineage were reviewed; older failures/branches and knowledge-usage history are not supplied and cannot be invented.

host_execution_plan: Host prerequisite: reverify pinned released data digests and frozen feature map/history policy against accepted setup artifacts. Raw data and digest execution are not available in this coding environment; no new verification is claimed.

At the protocol seed, compare each arm against the imported parent on cloned states: parameter names/shapes/counts, construction RNG, exact tensor state, all task train/eval probabilities, primary and auxiliary Dice buffers/counters and input immutability. No new model modules or state should exist. Gate changes are forward-identical.

Under disabled autocast, compare the joint_replay scalar hook with the frozen host default sum of four mean BCEs using exactly the same probability preprocessing. Require FP32 loss and dense-gradient agreement rtol1e-6/atol1e-7; coalesced sparse-gradient agreement rtol1e-5/atol1e-7. Run BF16 host path with rtol5e-3/atol1e-5 against the same-state parent. These are predeclared numerical acceptance checks, not performance tests. If failed, diagnose and stop before scientific comparison; never change the host default to pass.

Verify click_only dL/dp equals the true click-BCE derivative and is exactly zero in auxiliary columns; joint and blocked use true labels for all tasks; roll leaves click labels unchanged and preserves every auxiliary column count and joint triple histogram. No batch_dict/input tensors or host labels are modified. No RNG is consumed by hook calls.

Check finite forward/loss/backward under host BF16 and FP32, empty/short/full/noncontiguous histories, repeated categorical IDs, reserved/missing IDs and near-saturated probabilities. Check masked-history perturbation invariance, current action always unknown and checkpoint/device round trips.

Inspect table aliases from the real feature map. On diagnostic clones activate the zero-initialized output matrices of BOTH residual and context/history adapters. Confirm auxiliary-only ownership by group: no item/action/scorer/shared-primary-tower gradients; open context paths nonzero on a nondegenerate example, both blocked paths zero. At real initialization zero context gradients are expected and are not an isolation success criterion.

Without changing the training recipe, record preclip dense gradient norms and clip scale/frequency, click and auxiliary gradient norms/cosines on shared context rows, and actual click-shared updates on authorized training diagnostic batches at initialization and later if a host diagnostic interface exists. Coalesce sparse gradients, account for repeated IDs, and avoid full embedding densification. All diagnostics count against budget. If unavailable, record unavailable and limit mechanism claims to gate contrasts plus their clipping confound; do not add an unsupported API or use validation labels for gradients.

Run the host full-data from-scratch experiment interface for the4 variants in listed order after the common preflight. Use protocol seed20262027 and fixed optimizers/batches. Do not train in the coding jail. Collect failed receipts and elapsed costs, not only successes.

Validation analysis: predeclared paired click AUC contrasts are joint-click_only, joint-blocked, joint-roll, and blocked-click_only. Use receipt history bins empty/1-16/17-64/>64 with counts/positive/negative and insufficient marking; other slices are exploratory unless bins are frozen from training. Paired user-cluster bootstrap and paired-seed intervals require host-preserved identities and authorized interface; unavailable intervals must be reported as missing. This4-arm round is fixed-seed screening/attribution, not repeated support or a significance claim.
